name: tow
description: Search a connected Obsidian vault and project, tag project documents in .tow/, send selected content to the vault, and manage vault notes with content-preserving workflows.

interface.longDescription: Search a connected Obsidian vault and the current project by concept and text; tag project documents in .tow/ without changing their contents; and send selected content to the vault as a new note. Vault maintenance manages selected metadata and formatting while preserving content, with optional post-curation under your templates and explicit choices. Requires local vault access and Python 3.10+; optional parsing/ontology uses Node.js 22.18+ and the tag-ontology npm CLI. Your agent host processes opened content and controls permissions. TOW has no hosted backend.
defaultPrompt: Find my project notes about RAG.
Send this project note to my vault.
Suggest concept tags for these project documents.
